metadata.name: Glass
metadata.description: Made to impress: rounded boxes in the class color, the id on a dark pill above, the score as a meter on a pill below, and clothing or vehicle colors and tags inside the box.

object_box.label: Object box
object_box.description: The object's box in its class color, rounded, with a faint tint and a thin dark ring just outside so it separates from bright video. Dashed when the object is partly hidden.

id_label.label: Id label
id_label.description: The object's id in white on a dark pill floating above the box.

inside.label: Inside the box
inside.description: Puts the id inside the box's top-left corner instead of above it.

score_label.label: Score label
score_label.description: The detection score as a meter and a number on a dark pill under the box; the meter is in the class color, red below the low score.

low.label: Low score
low.description: Below this the meter turns red.

attributes.label: Attributes inside
attributes.description: What the detection says about the object, inside its box: clothing or vehicle colors as chips in the top-right corner, and a tag such as Bag in the top-left corner. Small boxes show none.

tag_corner.label: Tag corner
tag_corner.description: The inside corner the tag sits in.

minimum_size.label: Minimum box size
minimum_size.description: Smaller boxes show no attributes inside.

inside_parts.label: Attribute marks
inside_parts.description: The chips and tag that Attributes inside places.

tag_corner.label: Tag corner
tag_corner.description: The inside corner the tag sits in.

speed_arrow.label: Speed arrow
speed_arrow.description: An arrow in the class color from the box center.

part_link.label: Part link
part_link.description: Connects an object to its part, such as a person to their head: a light line between their centers with a dark-ringed dot on each end.

fallbacks.label: Other classes
fallbacks.description: Classified objects whose class has no object type of its own.

classifications.label: Vehicle
classifications.description: Cars, buses, trucks, bikes and other vehicles.

relations.label: Has part
relations.description: A line from an object to each of its parts.
